learning_outcomes.text: Analyzes the relationship between science, technology, and society.
Evaluates the contributions of ancient civilizations to science.
Compares the contributions of scientists to scientific development.
Evaluates engineering practices within the context of the historical development of science.

syllabus_topics: History of Science and Fundamental Concepts
Science in Early Civilizations (Mesopotamia and Egypt)
Science in the Indian and Chinese Civilizations
Science and Philosophy in Ancient Greece
Science and Technology in Islamic Civilization
The Renaissance and Science in Europe
Scientific Ethics and the Relationship Between Science and Society
bibliography: Atatürk, Nutuk, Ankara 1927 Atatürk'ün Söylev ve Demeçleri
Atatürk İlkeleri ve İnkılap Tarihi, (Edt. Abdullah İlgazi), Ankara 2011.
